role: Isolated Yggdrasil source-only research contribution to existing PR #1327. Amalgam PR #1278 is sole canonical learner and integration owner; no new controller, owner execution, canonical model, merge or deployment.

predecessor.known_negatives: KNOW21 sparse return memory lost to rolling/HMM; KNOW23 quarantined writer lost to strong HMM; KNOW27 single joint posterior forgot A in A-B-A; KNOW29 myopic EVI lost to entropy even under matched prior. Do not replay their consumed HELD evidence.

question: Can a nonprivileged bounded A/B archive of full opaque-action joint causal hypotheses preserve an old rule and reactivate it after witnessed return consequences faster than a fully trained switching Bayesian/HMM control with the identical hypothesis family?
novelty: Contrasts source-blind live multi-hypothesis reactivation and cold functional old-A retention under the exact KNOW26/27 six-map by 256-law hypothesis family. Earlier KNOW20-23 numeric-Beta slot studies and KNOW28 analytic pre-witness impossibility are NOT repeated.

source.train_prior: Use each mapping group's same existing already-consumed KNOW26 108 source witnesses to obtain FIT mapping prior. Both candidate and all fair controls receive identical historical FIT and online public evidence; count extra FIT actions separately.
source.public: At t=0..47 learner sees c=t%4, chosen opaque action a∈{0,1,2,3}, one actual witnessed binary consequence, local checkpoint. No mapping/law/phase/switch position, private coin, counterfactual label, next regime or future schedule ever enters policy.
source.hidden: For each of three evaluator-private physical maps, true Boolean law A=KNOW27 H0 for first segment, B=KNOW27 H2 for middle segment, A for final segment. Private boundaries t=12 and t=36 are known ONLY to evaluator; model code must not branch on t except allowed public context and stopping budget.
source.noise: For each (mid,seed,t), SHA256('know30:private:coin:v1:'+mid+':'+seed+':'+t) first8 bytes /2**64 supplies a common exogenous coin for all arms. Each source yields exactly one action-conditioned Bernoulli witness with .85/.15 probability as in KNOW27. Action-dependent observations can differ despite shared coins.
source.fit_regime_prototypes: Before HELD, all fair arms are supplied identical synthetic, explicitly labeled FIT A and FIT B witness datasets (32 witnesses per seed): A seeds [15311,15313], B seeds [15319,15329], each for three private map groups. Phase labels are TRAIN-only; NEVER revealed for HELD. These source-labelled examples are extra 128 FIT actions/group (384 overall), in addition to historical 108 mapping FIT/group. Count and hash source costs separately; no true map is supplied.
source.fit_law_noise: SHA256('know30:fit:coin:v1:'+mid+':'+seed+':'+t) first64 /2**64, action t%4, public c=t%4, only observed action reward. Held noise remains entirely separate.

frozen_worlds.action_schedule_primary: All fair models observe EXACTLY the same fixed public action a=t%4, one actual y per t. No learner selects actions in PRIMARY memory comparison. This is a deliberate same-information attribution experiment.
frozen_worlds.diagnostic_scoring: Evaluator scores withheld 4 high public c=4..7 no-op forecast using analytic Bernoulli expected Brier; evaluator's private scoring signal never fed into model; report prequential values before action witness, not future best-in-hindsight selection.
frozen_worlds.source_separation: New KNOW30 seeds/domain do not overlap consumed KNOW27/28/29 or KNOW20-23 and TGAP cohorts.

methods.candidate: Both full 6×256 posterior slots start from the same historical mapping FIT prior, then receive identical source-labelled A/B FIT witnesses into slot A/B before HELD. HELD phase belief P(A) begins 0.5; before each outcome mixes with hazard h=1/16. Likelihood update uses ONLY the two slot predictions for the chosen public action. Write the witnessed outcome into slot A only if posterior P(A)>=0.8, into B only if P(A)<=0.2, otherwise quarantine without assigning to a trained slot. Inactive slot weights remain byte-stable. At every t the policy returns the posterior-phase-weighted forecast, no true labels or switch timing. No active intervention selection.
methods.fully_fitted_switching_bayes: Same labelled FIT prototypes, hypothesis array capacity, initial phase belief 0.5, transition hazard h=1/16, public action and witnessed evidence. Non-privileged posterior phase filter; unlike selective-write candidate, SOFT fractional-responsibility Bayesian emission updates both slots at every held witness (sum fractional assimilation weights exactly 1). Explicitly label this as a two-slot mean-field/assumed-density HMM approximation, NOT exact joint HMM over two 256-table latent laws. Report this approximation limitation.
methods.hazard_selection: Single fixed h=1/16 preregistered from KNOW20-23; no held or FIT hazard optimization, no hidden schedule clock. Both candidate and HMM use identical h. Label HMM approximate rather than exact.
controls: Same prototypes/size phase-blind soft-update two-slot approximate HMM
Single continuously updated full JointHypothesis, same historical mapping FIT and pooled A+B labelled FIT source
Rolling-last8 single posterior refit on previous eight public witnesses, same map FIT prior and 2×64 labelled FIT historical observations retained in a separate ledger
No-FIT identical candidate (no historical mapping FIT or A/B labels; cold equal priors, report as an incomparable reduced-information ablation)
Private phase oracle using trained A/B prototypes; explicitly INELIGIBLE
methods.capacity: Both archive and HMM may use at most two copies of identical 6×256 posterior and common 64 latest public events; measure actual serialized byte maxima and CPU time. Rolling control uses same 64-history upper budget. The no-archive arm is strictly smaller and not the strongest matched-size competitor.
methods.action_cost: PRIMARY fixed tape charges no differential cost, identical action count and observations. No online entropy action study is authorized under this protocol; an active policy requires a separate new prereg and is not conflated with memory attribution.

metrics.primary: Mean return-A high-context analytic Brier after k∈{1,2,4,8} actually witnessed return consequences, 24 equal-weight worlds, and all return prequential forecast loss.
secondary: Old-A frozen archive checkpoint readout at time of nonprivileged first archive vs after B vs cold restore, compare predictive bytes and outputs; do not treat snapshot of an underlearned A as functional retention
HMM/rolling return-A high Brier at the same witness counts
B-stage prequential Brier, false switch count and detection delay
Pre-witness t36 branch-blind loss reported as intrinsic ambiguity, never scored as a required instant A-recognition gain
Matched observed vs assimilated witness counts per phase, checkpoint bytes, total Python CPU+wall excluding CI
All per-world paired differences and no-FIT negative
metrics.inference: Report all 24 world results, paired differences and uncertainty descriptively; this small structured synthetic cohort cannot establish population significance or native general intelligence.

frozen_decisions.H1: At t36 before any post-return witness, no source-blind model is expected to distinguish unseen B→A from B continuation; same public prefix must yield identical forecast. NO zero-evidence positive target.
frozen_decisions.H2: Candidate after k=4 and k=8 return witnesses must beat the best fully FIT conventional switching Bayes/HMM return high Brier by at least 0.005 absolute at BOTH k values, and win on at least 18/24 individual worlds at k8.
frozen_decisions.H3: Candidate B-stage mean high Brier may not exceed HMM B-stage high Brier by more than 0.005; protects against sacrificing changed-law learning to make return look good.
frozen_decisions.H4: After a public-evidence-triggered high-confidence switch to B, candidate A-slot bytes/readouts must be bit-identical until candidate returns to A. Also report original post-FIT A readout vs post-B readout and post-cold-restore; record A/B fit exposure and discarded/ambiguous HELD witness counts; no privileged hidden-boundary freeze.
frozen_decisions.H5: At least one witnessed outcome changes each filter's live P(A), typed/tamper/duplicate/out-of-order events fail closed; model receives neither private map/law nor HELD phase; report received and actually assigned witness counts separately. Never label a no-write protected slot as successfully learned unless original A functional Brier and observation count are recorded.
frozen_decisions.verdict: Research-only DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED requires H2+H3+H4+H5, otherwise DEVELOPMENT_MIXED or NO_GO; H1 is a feasibility/identifiability guard, not a success metric. Scientific gain and accepted native training remain false regardless of synthetic scores.

first_use: Commit THIS immutable protocol before implementation or accessing any new KNOW30 synthetic held witness. Focused unit tests may use constructed toy consequences but MUST NOT generate held world seeds; one single prospective primary result after both platforms focused/full-final and source-custody qualification. Never re-score, retune or extend consumed HELD after viewing results.
limits: No original-world first-use, no true native checkpoint, no model-owner loop, no claims about autonomous cognition, no scheduled jobs, no paid APIs, no new PR/merge; branch contributions cannot promote accepted main. Source-only experimental constraints and CI separated from scientific acceptance.
revision: Pre-first-use method concretization; initial prereg commit 13c0f0ad2622acc6ce16605f34ce8a4c59c16985 remains in history. No KNOW30 model code or HELD evidence yet.
